Guild Overview

!!! was the first unofficial guild - yes, even before Valor! It was basically started as a joke by a group of online friends (players like Smoosh and Hazelwood) from the good ol' days before Dungeon Runners even went public. It was common, at that time, to see players login to their respective worlds and great everybody by shouting !!! in chat. Most of the original players have gone, so I've created !!! as an homage to those friends who no longer play.  !!! is only about friendship - nothing more. There's no website, forums, no real organization.
